collections_policy.content: Collections Procedure v4.2. Standard terms: Net-30 from invoice date. Escalation tiers by days overdue: Tier 1 (1-15 days) = friendly reminder email to AP contact. Tier 2 (16-45 days) = firm reminder email CC'd to account owner. Tier 3 (46-75 days) = past-due notice + post to #ar-collections Slack for AM follow-up call. Tier 4 (76+ days) = final demand notice, place account on credit hold, escalate to Finance Director. Never escalate an invoice paid within the last 5 business days; verify recent payments first. All customer-facing notices require AR manager approval before sending.
